title: fix(release): the stale-prompts sweep retries a transient 5xx, and defers with a warning instead of reading as main red
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Fixes #28165
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:release.yml 的 stale-prompts 清扫(`scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs sweep`)读 GitHub API 遇到 5xx 或连接被重置时,按共享策略重试(每次读 3 次、间隔 500/1000 ms、整次运行最多 4 次重试);重试用尽仍失败时写一条 warning 和 job summary 小节后以 0 退出,不再把 main 的 Release 染红。
- 为什么改:2026-10-30 一天内 main 的 Release 因同一步骤遇到平台 502 红了 5 次,读起来像 main 红(p0),掩盖真正的发版失败;清扫每次 push 都会重跑,一次没读到只是推迟,不丢任何东西。
- 风险与回滚:改动限于 `scripts/` 下三个文件(未发布,无 changeset):清扫脚本本身;新的叶子模块 `scripts/board-read.mjs`(从 `check-issue-citations.mjs` 原样搬出的重试策略,零 import);`check-issue-citations.mjs` 改为 re-export,原有导入方不变。4xx、其它错误、取消请求失败仍然让 job 失败;in-flight 发布守卫的读取语义不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` 的 `retryingReads` / `expectOk`(重试与分类)和 `sweep` 里 catch `TransientReadFailure` 的分支(唯一以 0 退出的地方);`scripts/board-read.mjs`(确认是原样搬移、零 import)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`,预期末行 `146 cases across 35 batteries pass`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs`, plus the shared retry policy moved into a leaf module (`scripts/board-read.mjs`) and re-exported from `scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`. No workflow file is touched, so this PR is not Tier H.

- **Retry, through the shared policy, not a copy.** The sweep's GETs now go through `retryingReads`, which wraps the existing HTTP layer in `readBoard` under `BOARD_READ_RETRY`. That is the same policy and reader the release gate's full-battery read (`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` `readRuns`) uses since the publish-gate twin of this card: 3 attempts per read, 500 / 1000 ms backoff, at most 4 retries for the whole run (at most 3 s of sleep a sweep, against a 10-minute job timeout). Retried: an HTTP 5xx, or a named connection failure (`ECONNRESET`, `UND_ERR_SOCKET`; the policy's closed list). Final at once: any 4xx, and any other thrown error.
- **The outcome after the retries: a warning and exit 0.** A read still answering a transient failure comes back flagged, `expectOk` throws it as a `TransientReadFailure`, and `sweep` catches only that class. It prints one `::warning::` line on stderr naming the read, the last answer and the attempts, appends a `NOT READ this run` section to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`, and returns 0. Nothing was judged, so nothing was cancelled, and the next push to main re-runs the sweep from scratch. This is the only exit-0 failure path.
- **What still fails the job:** a 4xx, a body that does not add up, any other thrown error, and a cancel `POST` that does not answer 202/409. Writes are not retried: they pass through `retryingReads` unchanged.
- **The publish guard keeps its semantics.** The `in-flight` mode (`publishInFlight`) still reads through the bare HTTP layer. An unreadable answer is `in-flight` / `unreadable` after one request, which a new case pins.
- `sweep` now takes injectable `env`, `http`, `versionCommits`, `npmStateOf`, `now`, `sleep`, `log` and `warn`, and returns the exit code (`main` exits with it). The live defaults are unchanged.
- **The policy now lives in a leaf module.** `BOARD_READ_RETRY`, `RETRYABLE_NETWORK_CODES`, `retryableNetworkCode`, `boardReadBudget`, `readBoard` and `readFailure` moved unchanged from `check-issue-citations.mjs` into `scripts/board-read.mjs`, which imports nothing. The only addition is `export` on `sleepMs`, which the citation gate's defaults read. `check-issue-citations.mjs` re-exports every name, so its importers (`scheduled-full-run.mjs`) are unchanged. Its self-test still drives the policy. The import sits beside the re-export, so the census-pinned marker on line 204 does not move. `release-pending-publish.mjs` imports the leaf, so its `./x.mjs` closure is now `board-read.mjs` and `invoked-as.mjs` only. Importing the citation gate would have pulled in `pm/check-half-states.mjs` and the rest of its closure, which `release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test` cannot copy into its fixture repo. That was this PR's first CI red.

## H2: why the sweep keeps listing completed run 40078805767

**By design, so this PR leaves it as it is.** `collectWaitingRuns` finds each version commit's push run by `head_sha`, walking the commits newest first, and stops at the first run older than `WAITING_READ_BACK_DAYS` (30). It then checks that each run it found carries that version's publish job:

```js
const verify = carried && id !== String(currentRunId) && (r.status === 'waiting' || r.status === 'completed');
```

(`scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` L1228). This came in with `eead9dcf40`, the commit that added the targeted read. Its message says: "It checks that each run it finds carries that version's publish job". The self-test pins it: the `quiet` case reads completed runs 301 and 302, and the `wrong` case flags completed run 501, which has no publish job.

Read-only GETs show:

- 40078805767 is the push run of the 18.1.0 version commit `e649c2d9` ("chore: version packages (#25606)"), created 2026-10-24, completed / success.
- 38841989023, the run named at 13:42Z, is the push run of the previous version commit `e5136ff1` ("chore: version packages (next) (#23481)"), created 2026-10-16.

Both are inside the 30-day window. So every push re-reads the jobs listing of every version-commit push run from the last 30 days. 40078805767 is simply the newest of them, and it is read on every sweep until about 2026-11-23. The 502 lands on whichever of those jobs listings GitHub fails to answer. The run itself is not special: a public read of its jobs listing answered 200 with 6 jobs in 1.4 s. With this PR, a 502 on any of those reads is retried, and if it persists the sweep is deferred instead of turning red.

## Tests

The self-test has a new battery: `the sweep -> a transient read is retried under one budget, still failing it defers with a warning and exit 0, and a 4xx or a failed cancel stays red`. It has a floor of 10, and the battery floor went from 34 to 35. Its cases drive the whole `sweep` offline with a stubbed `http` and a real summary file in a temp dir:

- control: every read answers, so the stale prompt is cancelled, with exit 0, no backoff and no warning;
- **502 then 200** on a carried completed run's jobs listing (the incident's read): retried once after 500 ms, then swept (cancel sent, exit 0);
- **502 on every attempt**: 3 attempts and 500 + 1000 ms, nothing cancelled, exit 0;
- the same case says so: one `::warning::` line naming the read, `HTTP 502 after 3 attempts`, and a `NOT READ` summary section;
- **ECONNRESET then 200**: retried, then swept;
- an unnamed network error (`ENOTFOUND`): rethrown on the first attempt, so the job goes red;
- **404**: fatal at once, with one request, no backoff, nothing cancelled, and the error is not a deferral;
- a flapping API: one budget for the whole sweep, 4 retries, then the fifth transient answer defers;
- a cancel answering 502: sent once, not retried, exit 1 as before;
- the publish guard (`in-flight`) on a 502: still `unreadable`, so `in-flight`, after one request.

The existing pin `a probe answering non-200 -> the read throws (a red job)` still passes unchanged on the bare layer.

```
✓ release-pending-publish self-test: 146 cases across 35 batteries pass.
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
(The baseline at 361ea24245 was 136 cases across 34 batteries.)
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations, both via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored byte-identical</summary>

1. Retry removed (`if (method !== 'GET') return http(method, path);` replaced by an unconditional pass-through): the mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob `186cbaab511d` to `fb6db796de53`), and the self-test went red with 5 failures. Among them were "a 502 then a 200 ... swept", "a 502 on every attempt ...", "a connection reset ... swept" and "a flapping API ...". Restored: blob equals HEAD `186cbaab511d`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
2. Deferral removed (the `TransientReadFailure` catch rethrows every error): the mutation landed, and the self-test went red with 3 failures ("a 502 on every attempt ...", "and it says so ...", "a flapping API ..."). Restored byte-identical to HEAD.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `.github/workflows/release.yml`'s `stale-prompts` comment says "a failed read here must be loud (a red job on main)". After this PR, a read that keeps failing transiently is a `::warning::` annotation plus a summary section, not a red job. Every other failure is still red. The comment is in a Tier H file, so this PR does not edit it. carrier: none.
- The policy's network list stays closed (`ECONNRESET`, `UND_ERR_SOCKET`). Other connection failures, such as `ENOTFOUND` and `ETIMEDOUT`, stay final for the sweep exactly as they do for the release gate. Widening the list is a change to the shared policy, not to this script.
- No live `sweep` was run. All proof comes from the stubbed harness.
- `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` still imports the policy through `check-issue-citations.mjs`, so the citation gate's PM closure still loads in the `full-battery` job. Switching it to `./board-read.mjs` is a one-line follow-up, left out of this PR on purpose. carrier: none.

## Verification

I ran the local gates at `88c63cd785`, the final commit. The derived list came from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 34 commands, and all 34 exited 0. They include `node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`, `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, `pnpm check:issue-citations` and `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1937 cases). The `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation answered `34 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 34 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. Outside the derived set, these also exited 0: `node scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test` (169 cases, 16 batteries), `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --self-test`, `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`, and `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed files. No changeset: `scripts/` publishes nothing, hence `skip-changeset`.
